title: Rama laments for Seetha [contd.]
introduction: Rama laments for Seetha and becomes despondent. But at the advice of Lakshmana both of them start a search for Seetha, presuming that she might be available in the proximity. Later they embark on a thorough search in the entire forest and its mountains and at lakesides, but Seetha is unseen.

From here, until Rama meets Hanuma in next book Kishkindha, Rama's lamentation is continually portrayed. This may not be taken as a mere 'weeping' or 'bemoaning' of the principal character of the epic, but this has many poetics and romantics of epical poetry imbibed in it. An epic, basically, requires a hero to have his romantic attributes, naayaka lakshaNaaH and these 'wailings' will portray all of them. There are various, numerous and voluminous derivatives, meanings and commentaries, which cannot possibly be included in here, at this stage, except for passing references on them. Hence, this lengthy lamentation has lengthier romanticism.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे एक षष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 61st chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the first Epic poem of India

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा आश्रम पदम् शून्यम् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः |
रहिताम् पर्णशालाम् च प्रविद्धानि आसनानि च
अदृष्ट्वा तत्र वैदेहीम् संनिरीक्ष्य च सर्वशः |
उवाच रामः प्राक्रुश्य प्रगृह्य रुचिरौ भुजौ
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā āśrama padam śūnyam rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ |
rahitām parṇaśālām ca praviddhāni āsanāni ca
adṛṣṭvā tatra vaidehīm saṃnirīkṣya ca sarvaśaḥ |
uvāca rāmaḥ prākruśya pragṛhya rucirau bhujau
verses.translation: On seeing the vacant threshold of the hermitage and empty cottage of straw, also at the leaf-mat-seats that are utterly shattered, and not finding Vaidehi even on watchfully eyeing everywhere Rama shrieked loudly, and then on clasping the winning shoulders of Lakshmana he said this to him.

verses.devanagari:
क्व नु लक्ष्मण वैदेही कम् वा देशम् इतो गता |
केन आहृता वा सौमित्रे भक्षिता केन वा प्रिया
verses.iast:
kva nu lakṣmaṇa vaidehī kam vā deśam ito gatā |
kena āhṛtā vā saumitre bhakṣitā kena vā priyā
verses.translation: "Oh, Lakshmana, possibly where can be Vaidehi? Or, to which place she has gone from here? Or, Soumitri, who stole her away? Or, who has gorged up my ladylove?

glosses.meaning: from here, to which, place, or, she has gone
by whom, or, she is stolen
by whom, or, she is gorged.

verses.devanagari:
वृक्षेण आवार्य यदि माम् सीते हसितुम् इच्छसि |
अलम् ते हसितेन अद्य माम् भजस्व सुदुःखितम्
verses.iast:
vṛkśeṇa āvārya yadi mām sīte hasitum icchasi |
alam te hasitena adya mām bhajasva suduḥkhitam
verses.translation: "Oh, Seetha, if you have concealed yourself under trees wishing to poke fun at me, enough is your fun and games, get in touch with me now, as I am highly anguished...

verses.devanagari:
यैः सह क्रीडसे सीते विश्वस्तैः मृग पोतकैः |
एते हीनाः त्वया सौम्ये ध्यायन्ति अस्र आविल ईक्षणाः
verses.iast:
yaiḥ saha krīḍase sīte viśvastaiḥ mṛga potakaiḥ |
ete hīnāḥ tvayā saumye dhyāyanti asra āvila īkṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, meek Seetha, with which meekly young deer you were playing, all these are now broody with tearfully fluttery looks, without you...

verses.devanagari:
सीताया रहितो अहम् वै न हि जीवामि लक्ष्मण |
वृतम् शोकेन महता सीता हरणजेन माम्
पर लोके महाराजो नूनम् द्रक्ष्यति मे पिता |
verses.iast:
sītāyā rahito aham vai na hi jīvāmi lakśmaṇa |
vṛtam śokena mahatā sītā haraṇajena mām
para loke mahārājo nūnam drakṣyati me pitā |
verses.translation: "Really Lakshmana, I will not live long without Seetha, indeed I am enveloped in high anguish caused by the abduction of Seetha, and this alone will become a murderer, and on my going to other world when murdered by my own agony my father and that great king Dasharatha will definitely observe me in the other world...
notes: Some other mms contain the word mR^itam 'dead ...' instead of the word vR^itam 'enveloped...' 'when I am dead and gone to other world, there my father will ask me...' would then be its meaning.

glosses.meaning: in other, world [on my going there]

verses.devanagari:
कथम् प्रतिज्ञाम् संश्रुत्य मया त्वम् अभियोजितः
अपूरयित्वा तम् कालम् मत् सकाशम् इह आगतः |
काम वृत्तम् अनार्यम् माम् मृषा वादिनम् एव च
धिक् त्वाम् इति परे लोके व्यक्तम् वक्ष्यति मे पिता |
verses.iast:
katham pratiGYām saṃśrutya mayā tvam abhiyojitaḥ
apūrayitvā tam kālam mat sakāśam iha āgataḥ |
kāma vṛttam anāryam mām mṛṣā vādinam eva ca
dhik tvām iti pare loke vyaktam vakṣyati me pitā |
verses.translation: "When I go to other world after my death our father Dasharatha who is already staying there will deride me saying, 'when I have directed you for a fourteen year exile, and when you too have assuredly agreed and promised me for that term, how you have to my presence in this ultramundane world without completing that term of fourteen year exile, besides breaking your own word of honour... thus you have become a wilful disobedient, despicable and dishonest person, such as you are, fie on you...'

glosses.itrans: Dasharatha may deride me like this: maam
glosses.iast: ḍaśaratha may deride me like this: mām
glosses.devanagari: डशरथ मय् देरिदे मे लिके थिस्: मां
glosses.meaning: to me [to Dasharatha, he says 'to me you have promised']
that, time [term of exile] without, completing
how, to here [to other world, heaven] have come
at will, conducting [wilful disobedient - you Rama]
untruth, teller of [liar, dishonest - you Rama]
thus - in that way father Dasharatha accuses me

verses.devanagari:
विवशम् शोक संतप्तम् दीनम् भग्न मनोरथम्
माम् इह उत्सृज्य करुणम् कीर्तिः नरम् इव अन्ऋजुम् |
क्व गच्चसि वरारोहे मा मोत्सृज्य - मा मा उत्सृज्य - सुमध्यमे
त्वया विरहितः च अहम् त्यक्ष्ये जीवितम् आत्मनः |
verses.iast:
vivaśam śoka santaptam dīnam bhagna manoratham
mām iha utsṛjya karuṇam kīrtiḥ naram iva an.hṛjum |
kva gaccasi varārohe mā motsṛjya - mā mā utsṛjya - sumadhyame
tvayā virahitaḥ ca aham tyakṣye jīvitam ātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Anguish seared and bewildered me and I am woebegone with broken down buoyancy, and oh, beautiful lady, jilting such an woeful one as I am, where you are going now, as with prestige jilting a prevaricator? And if you shun me I will have to shun my life..." Thus Rama bewailed imaging her right in his front and running away.

glosses.meaning: not, truthful one, from a man, [from a prevaricator]
of mine, live, I will leave off - shun away.

verses.devanagari:
इति इव विलपन् रामः सीता दर्शन लालसः
न ददर्श सुदुःख आर्तो राघवो जनक आत्मजाम् |
verses.iast:
iti iva vilapan rāmaḥ sītā darśana lālasaḥ
na dadarśa suduḥkha ārto rāghavo janaka ātmajām |
verses.translation: Though that legatee of Raghu is desperate for seeing Seetha, though he is highly anguished and agonised, though he bewailed this way, that Rama has not found Janaka's daughter, Seetha.

glosses.meaning: Janaka's, daughter, not, he has seen - found.

verses.devanagari:
अनासादयमानम् तम् सीताम् शोकपरायणम्
पंकम् आसाद्य विपुलम् सीदन्तम् इव कुंजरम् |
लक्ष्मणो रामम् अत्यर्थम् उवाच हित काम्यया
verses.iast:
anāsādayamānam tam sītām śokaparāyaṇam
paṃkam āsādya vipulam sīdantam iva kuṃjaram |
lakṣmaṇo rāmam atyartham uvāca hita kāmyayā
verses.translation: To him who is unable to find Seetha, and who is sinking in sadness as with an elephant sinking in a chasmal mud, Lakshmana spoke to such a Rama in a positive manner desiring his wellbeing.

glosses.meaning: one who is not, getting at
one to sadness, who surrendered himself to - sinking
chasmal, mud, on getting at, sinking

verses.devanagari:
मा विषादम् महाबुद्धे कुरु यत्नम् मया सह |
इदम् गिरि वरम् वीर बहु कन्दर शोभितम्
verses.iast:
mā viṣādam mahābuddhe kuru yatnam mayā saha |
idam giri varam vīra bahu kandara śobhitam
verses.translation: "Oh, well-informed one, do not get into desperation, you make efforts along with me, and oh, brave one, this best mountain is beaming forth with many caves, she may be there somewhere.

glosses.meaning: me, along with, efforts, you make

verses.devanagari:
प्रिय कानन संचारा वन उन्मत्ता च मैथिली |
सा वनम् वा प्रविष्टा स्यात् नलिनीम् वा सुपुष्पिताम्
सरितम् वा अपि संप्राप्ता मीन वंजुल सेविताम् |
verses.iast:
priya kānana saṃcārā vana unmattā ca maithilī |
sā vanam vā praviṣṭā syāt nalinīm vā supuṣpitām
saritam vā api samprāptā mīna vaṃjula sevitām |
verses.translation: "Maithili is a fascinated saunterer in woodlands so she might have entered the forest, she is even infatuated with waters, so she might have gone to the fully bloomed lotus-lake, or to the river that is adorned by fishes and cane-breaks.

glosses.meaning: for water [here, not forest but waters,] infatuated, even
entered, she will be - she might have
by fishes, cane-breaks, one which is adorned by

verses.devanagari:
वित्रासयितु कामा वा लीना स्यात् कानने क्वचित्
जिज्ञासमाना वैदेही त्वाम् माम् च पुरुषर्षभ |
तस्या हि अन्वेषणे श्रीमन् क्षिप्रम् एव यतावहे
verses.iast:
vitrāsayitu kāmā vā līnā syāt kānane kvacit
jiGYāsamānā vaidehī tvām mām ca puruṣarṣabha |
tasyā hi anveṣaṇe śrīman kṣipram eva yatāvahe
verses.translation: "Or, wishing to know our reaction when she scares us with her prank, Maithili might have squirreled away into forest. Oh, honourable brother, let us endeavour quickly to search her.

glosses.meaning: to scare [us,] wishing to, or else
interested in knowing [our reaction for her pranks,] or
in forest, somewhere, wrapped up in [squirreled away herself]
quickly, thus, we have to endeavour

verses.devanagari:
वनम् सर्वम् विचिनुवो यत्र सा जनक आत्मजा |
मन्यसे यदि काकुत्स्थ मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः
verses.iast:
vanam sarvam vicinuvo yatra sā janaka ātmajā |
manyase yadi kākutstha mā sma śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama of Kakutstha, if you consider that we shall search the forest in its entirety to locate where she that Janaka's daughter might be, let us quickly do so. But do not engulf your heart in sadness." Thus Lakshmana advised Rama.

glosses.meaning: in entirety, forest, let us search

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु सौहार्दात् लक्ष्मणेन समाहितः |
सह सौमित्रिणा रामो विचेतुम् उपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu sauhārdāt lakṣmaṇena samāhitaḥ |
saha saumitriṇā rāmo vicetum upacakrame
verses.translation: When Lakshmana good-heartedly spoke this way, Rama self-collectedly made a headway for the search of Seetha along with Soumitri.

glosses.meaning: this way, who is spoken to

verses.devanagari:
तौ वनानि गिरीन् चैव सरितः च सरांसि च |
निखिलेन विचिन्वन्तौ सीताम् दशरथ आत्मजौ
verses.iast:
tau vanāni girīn caiva saritaḥ ca sarāṃsi ca |
nikhilena vicinvantau sītām daśaratha ātmajau
verses.translation: Those two sons of Dasharatha have started a thorough search for Seetha in forests, on mountains, also thus at rivers and lakes.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य शैलस्य सानूनि शिलाः च शिखराणि च |
निखिलेन विचिन्वन्तौ न एव ताम् अभिजग्मतुः
verses.iast:
tasya śailasya sānūni śilāḥ ca śikharāṇi ca |
nikhilena vicinvantau na eva tām abhijagmatuḥ
verses.translation: On searching whole of mountainsides of that Mt. Chitrakuta, where their hermitage is there, even in its caves, crags, and mountain peaks they have not found Seetha.

glosses.meaning: that, [that mountain where their cottage is there - Chitrakuta,] mountain's, on sides

verses.devanagari:
विचित्य सर्वतः शैलम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् |
न इह पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीम् पर्वते शुभाम्
verses.iast:
vicitya sarvataḥ śailam rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt |
na iha paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīm par.hvate śubhām
verses.translation: On exploring everywhere on that mountain Rama said to Lakshmana, "oh, Soumitri, here on this mountain I do not descry auspicious Vaidehi."

glosses.meaning: Rama, everywhere, on that mountain, on exploring

verses.devanagari:
ततो दुःख अभिसंतप्तो लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
विचरन् दण्डक अरण्यम् भ्रातरम् दीप्त तेजसम्
verses.iast:
tato duḥkha abhisaṃtapto lakṣmaṇo vākyam abravīt |
vicaran daṇḍaka araṇyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam
verses.translation: While roving searchingly in Dandaka forest Lakshmana who is tormented by anguish said a sentence to his greatly resplendent brother Rama.

glosses.meaning: to greatly, resplendent, to brother - Rama

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्स्यसि त्वम् महाप्राज्ञ मैथिलीम् जनक आत्मजाम् |
यथा विष्णुः महाबाहुः बलिम् बद्ध्वा महीम् इमाम्
verses.iast:
prāpsyasi tvam mahāprāGYa maithilīm janaka ātmajām |
yathā viṣṇuḥ mahābāhuḥ balim baddhvā mahīm imām
verses.translation: "Oh, insightful brother, you will reacquire Janaka's daughter Maithili, as Vishnu once subjugated Emperor Bali and reacquired this earth."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु वीरेण लक्ष्मणेन स राघवः |
उवाच दीनया वाचा दुःख अभिहत चेतनः
verses.iast:
evam uktaḥ tu vīreṇa lakṣmaṇena sa rāghavaḥ |
uvāca dīnayā vācā duḥkha abhihata cetanaḥ
verses.translation: But when the valiant Lakshmana addressed him in that way, Raghava whose thinking is marred by poignance spoke these pathetic words.

verses.devanagari:
वनम् सुविचितम् सर्वम् पद्मिन्यः फुल्ल पंकजाः |
गिरिः च अयम् महाप्राज्ञ बहु कन्दर निर्झरः |
न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीम् प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम्
verses.iast:
vanam suvicitam sarvam padminyaḥ phulla paṃkajāḥ |
giriḥ ca ayam mahāprāGYa bahu kandara nir.hjharaḥ |
na hi paśyāmi vaidehīm prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm
verses.translation: "This forest in its entirety, these lotus-lakes with their blossomed lotuses, and this mountain with its many caves and mountain-rapids, all are evidently searched. But, oh, sensible brother, I do not descry Vaidehi who is loftier than my lives."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् स विलपन् रामः सीता हरण कर्शितः |
दीनः शोक समाविष्टो मुहूर्तम् विह्वलो अभवत्
verses.iast:
evam sa vilapan rāmaḥ sītā haraṇa karśitaḥ |
dīnaḥ śoka samāviṣṭo muhūrtam vihvalo abhavat
verses.translation: Lamenting in this way Rama languished owing to the abduction of Seetha and became a pitiable one, and while sadness besieging him he is perturbed for a moment.

glosses.meaning: by Seetha's, abduction, languishing [appears to be]

verses.devanagari:
स विह्वलित सर्व अंगो गत बुद्धिः विचेतनः |
निषसाद आतुरो दीनो निःश्वस्य अशीतम् आयतम्
verses.iast:
sa vihvalita sarva aṃgo gata buddhiḥ vicetanaḥ |
niṣasāda āturo dīno niḥśvasya aśītam āyatam
verses.translation: All the limbs of Rama are fluttered, his faculty has become functionless, his fervour is frozen, he is forlorn and flustered, and such as he is he sank down suspiring swelteringly and lengthily.

verses.devanagari:
बहुशः स तु निःश्वस्य रामो राजीव लोचनः |
हा प्रिये ति विचुक्रोश बहुशो बाष्प गद्गदः
verses.iast:
bahuśaḥ sa tu niḥśvasya rāmo rājīva locanaḥ |
hā priye ti vicukrośa bahuśo bāṣpa gadgadaḥ
verses.translation: Suspiring repeatedly he that lotus-eyed Rama shrieked repeatedly and loudly thus as, 'ha, Seetha...' with tears stifling his throat.

glosses.meaning: lotus, eyed one, he, that Rama

verses.devanagari:
तम् सान्त्वयामास ततो लक्ष्मणः प्रिय बान्धवम् |
बहु प्रकारम् शोक आर्तः प्रश्रितः प्रश्रित अंजलिः
verses.iast:
tam sāntvayāmāsa tato lakṣmaṇaḥ priya bāndhavam |
bahu prakāram śoka ārtaḥ praśritaḥ praśrita aṃjaliḥ
verses.translation: Though Rama has many kinsfolk who hold him dear he is now left with a single one, namely Lakshmana, and that obedient brother Lakshmana who is already anguished for Rama's sadness, then adjoining his palms obediently started to pacify Rama with divers methods.

glosses.meaning: loving, kinsfolk [one who has kinsfolk who hold him dear, namely Rama]
by sadness [of Rama,] [who is already] anguished, [such a] Lakshmana

verses.devanagari:
अनादृत्य तु तत् वाक्यम् लक्ष्मण ओष्ठ पुट च्युतम् |
अपश्यन् ताम् प्रियाम् सीताम् प्राक्रोशत् स पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
anādṛtya tu tat vākyam lakṣmaṇa oṣṭha puṭa cyutam |
apaśyan tām priyām sītām prākrośat sa punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: But disavowing the word of advice that fell out from the cupped lips of Lakshmana, Rama stridently yelled again and again when his dear Seetha has become unseeable.
